beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Remember when you saved me the window seat? I thought I mattered to you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I knew you liked the view.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Proof that you noticed small things.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Also, I needed the aisle seat to stretch my bad knee.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So my fondest memory of being understood was your knees negotiating space.

reason: B4 previously described less legroom beside A without establishing a benefit to B; the new explicit aisle-knee motive supports A5 accusation.
comparison: S223-a changes the meaning of a seating favor through a stated physical motive; S223-b changes the meaning of displaying an early painting.
scope: Local writer revision only; no technical retries or fresh-review correction counters changed.
